provenance.default_rationale: all-equal until the navigator elicits real pairwise judgments; equal weights are the only honest default - no preference was ever stated in any source artifact

editing_note: Edit ONLY the upper triangle on the Saaty 1-9 scale (1 = equal, 3 = moderately more important, 5 = strongly, 7 = very strongly, 9 = extremely; use 1/3, 1/5, 1/7, 1/9 for the inverse) and mirror each edit with its reciprocal in the lower triangle. Rows and columns follow the frozen criteria order [strategic_fit, validated_demand, tech_econ_feasibility]. Any edit whose Saaty Consistency Ratio exceeds 0.1 makes every portfolio run fail loudly with AHP_INCONSISTENT until fixed - the matrix is never silently rescaled.
